title: 4048. Count Values With Equally Spaced Occurrences I

examples.explanation: 1 is special because it occurs exactly three times at equally spaced indices 0, 2, and 4. 5 is special because it occurs exactly three times at equally spaced indices 3, 5, and 7. 8 is not special because it occurs only twice. Therefore, the answer is 2.
8 is not special because it does not occur exactly three times. Therefore, the answer is 0.
8 occurs at indices 0, 3, and 4, which are not equally spaced. 6 occurs only twice. Therefore, no integer is special.

hints: 1a (Brute Force). Count each value's occurrences, then enumerate all triples of indices i < j < k. Count a triple if nums[i] == nums[j] == nums[k], j - i == k - j, and the value appears exactly three times in the array.
2a (Grouping Indices). Group occurrence indices by value. Count the groups containing exactly three indices whose two consecutive gaps are equal.
